project_info.color_palette: Pale Yellow, Bright Yellow, Black, White, Charcoal

main_subject.detail: A centered black ticket-shaped header with logo and {{HEADLINE}}, followed by four yellow tier coupons on a white rounded panel.
main_subject.style: Bold branded discount system, clean ecommerce graphic design

items: Top Center: Black ticket header with REF_BRAND_LOGO and {{HEADLINE}}.
Top Left: Small dumbbell prop over the white content panel.
Middle: Four matching yellow coupon tiles in a two-by-two grid.
Bottom: Large black CTA line on pale-yellow background.
Background: White rounded panel centered on pale-yellow canvas.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: High legibility, shallow shadows, clean black-yellow brand contrast

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: Create a square Ultimate Sup buy-more-save-more voucher poster. Preserve the pale-yellow canvas and white rounded panel. Use REF_BRAND_LOGO inside a black ticket header with {{HEADLINE}}, then arrange four yellow coupons in a two-by-two grid showing approved tier values and spend thresholds. Add a small dumbbell upper left and {{FOOTER_CTA}} at the bottom. Keep the coupon geometry, logo/header position, and bold black-yellow typography hierarchy fixed.
prompt.negative_prompt: wrong number of tiers, unapproved price or currency, distorted logo, low-legibility text, extra products, muted colors, watermark, cropped ticket edges

assets.name: Branded voucher-grid layout
assets.usage: Preserve ticket header and two-by-two coupon grid.

assets.name: Ultimate Sup logo
assets.usage: Keep black-header placement and do not alter the mark.

assets.name: Dumbbell graphic
assets.source: Attach approved prop or recreate neutral dumbbell
assets.usage: Maintain as small sports cue only.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach REF_LAYOUT and REF_BRAND_LOGO. Compose exact voucher copy and values after generation when text must be exact.

substitutable_fields.replacement_rule: Replace with an approved offer headline.
Use current SGD voucher values and thresholds.
